title: The Grip Needs to Be Tighter
text: The Grip Needs to Be Tighter. The gripping action needs to be tighter. This gadget is easy to open and close, attach and detach. And it seems to hold the pan, but it wobbles due to the grip not being tight enough. It doesn't inspire confidence that the grip will hold.

product_metadata.title: ROCKURWOK Replacement Cookware Handle, Detachable | Removable, Gripper for Cake Model, Saucepan, Skillet, Fry Pan and Bowl
features: [Versatility] This removable handle applies for any vertical edges. The maximum thickness that can be clamped is 0.1"( 2.5mm ), suitable for cake model, saucepan, skillet, fry pan and metal bowl with vertical edges. Can be also used as gripper and retriever
[Easy to use] It is super convenient to remove and install the handles. No need to drill or screw, time to choose a new style cookware handle
[Slid-resistance] The serrated rubber ensures the stability of this handle. The curve handle and frosted surface are designed for better grip. It keeps a firm hold and won’t get loose
[Thicker material] This handle is thicker than other brands, made of heat-resistance plastic and durable stainless steel, totally weights 0.42 pounds

[Heat-resistance] A piece of metal which at one end protects the handle from heat, and the rubber, metal and plastic all take high-temperature-resistance materials. But do not put this handle directly on the fire and do not heat it for a long time
